note: Dated, expiring risk acceptances consumed by scripts/audit-check.mjs. Rationale and evidence for each entry live in SECURITY-AUDIT.md. Adding an entry here is a security decision and should be reviewed as one.

semantics.key: advisory + package. Duplicates are rejected, because a lookup over duplicates would make policy order-dependent.
semantics.approvedSeverity: Maximum. If the advisory is later reported at a higher severity the exception does not apply. `critical` can never be approved.
semantics.expires: EXCLUSIVE, YYYY-MM-DD, evaluated at 00:00 UTC. The exception applies while now < expires, so the date itself is the first day it no longer suppresses.
semantics.unused: FATAL. Every entry must correspond to a currently reported advisory. An unused but unexpired entry is dormant suppression authority: if a dependency change reintroduced the advisory it would be suppressed again with no human re-review. Delete entries when the advisory disappears.

exceptions.reason: No patched version exists (affected <= 3.0.3, the latest release). Dev-only: reached only through eslint-config-next (@next/eslint-plugin-next, fast-glob, micromatch) since the Tailwind 4 migration removed the tailwindcss paths on 2026-10-16; the production-graph audit is clean.
